items.quote: *From Google* Danny has done some commercial window cleaning on show homes across shropshire for myself and never lets me down! I would recommend his company for all aspects of window cleaning cleaning domestic and commercial!

items.quote: *google review* Really good service from Drayton Exterior Cleaning. I particularly like the customer portal as it's easy to see when the next clean is due and communicate if you need to change anything. Everything feels very organised and professional. Great job on the windows too!

items.quote: Highly Recommended 2nd to none. Reliable and Professional 👍🤙

items.quote: Danny has done an incredible job to all our windows and upvc - we are constantly let down by the previous guy but Danny has restored our faith! He ensured everything was gleaming and took a great deal of pride in the job! Simply incredible! The before and after speaks for itself!
items.name: Sian Cage
Sam Day
items.quote:
After seeing Danny’s advert on Facebook, I was given a simple online quote and Danny came out to have a look at the job a couple of days later. He sent me over a link to an online portal where everything to do with my window cleaning is managed and noted and so easy to access! 
But the biggest Wow 🤩 is how my windows are so sparkly! ✨ they honestly look brand new! It’s made my whole house feel so much brighter and cleaner! If your thinking about it, do it! 
I promise he won’t disappoint! 
Thank you Danny- I Can’t wait to have you back! 🧽 ✨
